title: advisory_bump@1: an advisory intake source and a build spec that bumps one advisory per run

story.i_want_to: a dependency advisory reported on a repository's default branch to become one story that a spec agent bumps, verifies and merges
story.so_that: the advisory bumps that recur across loopctl, loopctl-runner, home_care_billing and claude-config (about 14 PRs in the 30 days to 2026-11-07) stop costing a session each and stop rediscovering the same audit traps

rationale: Epic 48's PRD names the dependency-advisory bumper as the next :build spec and says it waits for an advisory intake source and Gate B entries. KB f07c9d2b, 7209856a, 7fcc62a6, 3c205dc2 and 2c5ae474 record five traps a session meets on these bumps; the runner template carries them.

acceptance_criteria.description: An advisory intake path records one intake record per (repository, advisory id), idempotent on that pair, from a scheduled audit the runner performs and reports; no reporter text exists on this path.
Registry entry advisory_bump@1 with archetype :build; the payload names the advisory, package, fixed version and the repository's current ignore entry if any.
The spec never adds or extends an ignore_advisories entry: when no fixed version is reachable within the pin, the run escalates with the reason enum fix_breaks_pin or no_fixed_version.
The verifier re-runs the repository's audit command at the head and passes only when the named advisory no longer reports and the CI ignore list equals the mix.exs list (KB 7fcc62a6).
The outcome row records merged, reverted, CI result, merge gate decision, and advisory_cleared from the verifier's audit, never from the implementer's report.

test_cases.name: an ignore is refused
steps: screen a diff that adds an ignore_advisories entry

test_cases.name: tenant isolation
steps: two tenants report the same advisory
expected_results: two records, each visible only to its tenant

technical_notes: Enroll loopctl-runner first: small lockfile, fast CI.
A new env var for the audit schedule, if any, gets its deploy/FLY_SECRETS.md row in the same change.
